run_port_server: run a threaded HTTP server on a specified port to manage TCP port allocation for unit tests
allocate_port_via_http: request an available TCP port by sending a GET request to the /get endpoint of the port server
drop_port_via_http: release an allocated port back to the pool by sending a GET request to the /drop/PORT endpoint
dump_port_server_version: print the port server version number by running the script with the dump_version argument
dump_port_pool_state: dump the current pool and in-use port state as YAML by sending a GET request to the /dump endpoint
